qualifying_human_studies.title: The capacity of short-chain fructo-oligosaccharides to stimulate faecal bifidobacteria: a dose-response relationship study in healthy humans.
qualifying_human_studies.primary_endpoint: Fecal bifidobacteria (surrogate); not clinical symptom benefit
qualifying_human_studies.notes: Forty healthy adults, five randomized arms, seven days; microbiome surrogate benefit, no between-group digestive symptom benefit. Subset report of PMID15585783, not independent replication. Actilight scFOS composition was 44% GF2, 46% GF3 and 10% GF4. Bloating intensity was higher at 2.5 and 5 g/day although digestive symptom frequency was unchanged; this does not establish universal tolerability or clinical efficacy.
